entities.name: Laquatus
entities.description: Merfolk ambassador of the cephalid Empire on Otaria, a blue mage scheming for power.

entities.name: Cephalid Empire
entities.description: Empire Laquatus represented, which became dominant in Otaria's oceans.

entities.name: Berbous Merfolk empire
entities.description: Merfolk nation overthrown at its rebirthing ceremony.

entities.name: Mirari
entities.description: Powerful object sought by Laquatus and others.

entities.name: Llawan
entities.description: Cephalid who imprisoned Laquatus and destroyed his army.

entities.name: Krosa
entities.description: Place where Kamahl first killed Laquatus.

events.summary: Laquatus distracts the Berbous emperor during the rebirthing ceremony while the Cephalids replace the merfolk eggs, decimating the merfolk.
Laquatus is made Ambassador for his ability to change forms.
events.quote: He was made Ambassador for his ability to change freely

events.summary: Laquatus hypnotizes Kirtar and Cabal members with false memories.
events.quote: Laquatus hypnotized Kirtar and numerous members of the Cabal

events.summary: Laquatus's Mirari quest fails; Llawan imprisons him in the Otaria Chasm and destroys his army.
events.quote: Laquatus ended up imprisoned in the Otaria Chasm by Llawan

events.summary: Kamahl kills Laquatus in Krosa, then again when he returns as a Mirari-mutated zombie.

relations.quote: Ambassador Laquatus represented the cephalid 's Empire
